info.title: /IOTCONNECT™ User API
info.description:
User REST API contains information of User, Role and Entity modules.

Headers

Needed Headers for all the API.

Authorization     Bearer + access_token (Generated From api/v1.1/auth/login API)
Content-Type    application/json

post.description:
An entity in IoTConnect is the company/location-based hierarchy where users can manage different entities/companies under which several devices and users can be managed. The entity facilitates a user to control multiple sub-companies under a parent company. When you create a company, an entity gets created automatically, which is considered as a parent entity of your company.

This API endpoint allows you to add new entities for your company. Such new entities get their place under a parent entity. Here name, parentEntityGuid, address, city, countryGuid, stateGuid are mandatory. If you opt to create an entity owner, firstName, lastName, userId, roleGuid, timeZoneGuid are mandatory.

put.description:
To update entity name, location details, or a parent-child architecture relationship, use this API endpoint. You need to send entityGuid in request url and updated entity details in the request body.

Here, you even have an option to set an existing user as the owner of the entity. For that, you need to send a user guid in ownerUserGuid parameter. To arrange a new user as an entity owner, you need to send user details in the userInfo parameter.

put.description:
When you create a user, default preferences set automatically for that user. Nevertheless, you can update those preferences anytime later.

This API endpoint allows you to update currently logged in user’s preferences details.

Here, you have an option to opt for notifications like email, sms, push. In case of email notifications, you have a choice whether you want to receive notifications on the primary email address (user’s login id) or secondary email address. If you opt for a secondary email, you need to enter that email address in alternateEmailID parameter. To change the user’s time zone, you need to send timeZoneGuid in the parameter. You can also get the list of available time zones from Master API.
